candidates.label: Proposal and owner-decision events in the ontology stream
evidence: A single ontology-artifact stream can calculate candidates, rejected revisions, accepted revisions, and retirements without making validation authoritative.

candidates.label: Separate semantic and governance streams joined by exact references
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 treats semantic and authority kinds as orthogonal and permits typed directional relations.

candidates.label: Mutable status fields inside previously appended events
evidence: The selected event-sourcing premise makes events canonical and append-only.
rejectionReasons: Mutating an appended event destroys canonical history and lets status edits manufacture lifecycle or authority changes.

candidates.label: Defer governance-event topology
evidence: Deferral permits mechanics-only work but blocks acceptance and rejection lifecycle implementation.

candidates.label: Stop governance-event design
evidence: Stopping terminates this continuation without mutation.
